text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: 'Hard work always pays off.'

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "I'll do my best today too."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh.

New Year's Day. At her request, we were 
training for the Nikkei Sho.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...! Hah, hah, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, my body feels so heavy! My arms 
hurt...!)
choice_data_list: Last set! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Just one more push, one more push, one 
more push, one more push—)

And with only a few reps left to go, she 
abruptly stopped what she was doing.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! I was just a little short...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(It hurt, it felt so heavy... I couldn't 
push through...)

Actually, I have had one concern lately. 
During training, there have been more and 
more times when I couldn't firmly hold my 
ground.

The workload shouldn't be an issue, and 
from the looks of it, she doesn't seem to 
be injured either.

Psychogenic—perhaps something is troubling 
her.

She mentioned that she consults her 
Trainer about matters regarding training.

"Could it be about something outside of 
training, then? I feel like waiting until 
she brings it up, but... I can't help but 
be worried."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, can I do... one more? I'll see it 
through to the end this time—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, Th-That's... um."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (My legs are losing their footing...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Hang in there... Come on, hang in there!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Ever since that day, non-stop. 
............)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Well, of course they'd notice. Then 
shouldn't I just say it? If I confide in 
Trainer-san...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...The truth is—

Win Variation started to say something, 
but suddenly glanced down at my hands and 
fell silent.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, that writer's callus... When did you 
get that?

Told to look at my hands, I see it's 
definitely there. It wasn't there back 
during the debut race, though—
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's because I took such thorough 
notes while gathering the materials.

text_block_list.text:
"Racing is an information war. It likely 
came about as she progressed through the 
Twinkle Series and carried out her 
research."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: To have ended up like this...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Right, Trainer has been working hard for 
my sake all this time.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I need to ignore my weakness 
and do my best, but...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (To think they're in a state like this—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, I can't tell them. Not when 
Trainer is working so hard for me...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Suppress it, wipe it away cleanly. Even 
if I can't do it now, as long as I keep 
struggling, someday—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What I'm worried about is... well... 
It's kind of personal, you know.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to think a bit more 
and solve it myself...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine. I'm sure it's the kind of 
worry that goes away once things change!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I'm so sorry, Trainer. I will. I will 
make sure to erase this feeling from my 
heart...!)

I had been worried, but... perhaps in her 
mind, she already sees the path to a 
solution.

Either way, judging by that answer, it's 
probably a subject they'd rather not touch 
on.
choice_data_list:
(There's only so much I can do as I am 
now.)

(There's only so much I can do as I am 
now.)

text_block_list.text:
For now, if only I could offer something 
that would make them feel even a little 
better...
choice_data_list:
How about having some oshiruko for a 
change of pace?

Let's check out the shopping district's 
New Year sales for a change of pace.

How about we watch the first sunset of the 
year for a change of pace?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Oshiruko? ...Ah, today's New Year's Day, 
isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "W-Wah, um! Happy New Year!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Oshiruko... Yeah, I'd love some!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I remember Verxina 
saying something about a modified recipe 
that adds fruit..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
My heart was pounding wondering if it's 
really okay to do this, so I've never 
touched it before... Alright, I'll go ask 
and see!

And so, together with her, I made a 
fruit-infused variation of oshiruko—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Pineapples, mandarin oranges... All right, 
we just stew it like this, right!

Peeking at the recipe in my hand, the word 
"apple" is written right there. ...Did she 
forget it?
choice_data_list: So I don't need to add apples?
Should I leave the apples out?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, ahh...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that having the 
season's first apple might be too much of 
a luxury for me right now...
choice_data_list: (First apple of the year?)... Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. The first apple of the 
season needs to be more, like— only when 
my mind and body are pure and in tune...!"

She had an extraordinary obsession with 
apples to begin with. If she believed it 
to be true, then it must be so.

—And with that, the fruit-infused oshiruko 
was finished, without any apples!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Alright then, thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *chew*...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Th-This is amazing! It's sweet, sour, 
and so delicious! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Phew.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
New Year's sales— Ah, today's New Year's 
Day, isn't it?! Whoa, Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
New Year's sales... sounds lively. Yeah, I 
wanna go!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, what a crowd! Business is 
booming, huh...!

In addition to New Year's sales at the 
shops, many stalls also seemed to be open.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Takoyaki, steamed buns... There's even a 
target toss. ...Ah."
choice_data_list: Is there anything you want to eat?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Actually, I was kinda curious about 
the target toss. Well, less the target 
toss and more "that girl," really.

Following their gaze to the target gallery 
prize shelf— perhaps it had been there for 
a long time. There sat a cat plushie 
wrapped in slightly soiled plastic.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Mind if I go give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Alright! I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the target shooting game began—

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
“—So close! Was that a kitty? Come on, 
aim, aim!”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ugh, next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Too bad! Next one's the last!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Focus, focus...!
And then—!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you won! Congratulations~!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I did it……! I got it, fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...Once I get home, I'll clean it up 
and display it in my room.

We walked through the shopping district 
for a while after, and Win Variation held 
the cat plushie tight in both hands the 
entire time.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Phew.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The first sunset of the year... Ah, so 
today really is New Year's Day, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "W-Wah, um! Happy New Year!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Sunset means the evening sun, right? Whoa, 
that sounds nice...!

And so, after transferring trains multiple 
times, we arrived at a beach famous for 
its beautiful sunsets.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! It's so pretty...! The sky and 
the sea are sparkling, full of light—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm sinking...

For a while after that, Win Variation 
quietly watched the setting sun sink below 
the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Normally, people think of the sunrise, 
right? So I was wondering what it'd be 
like, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It was so beautiful. It's still 
burned right into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I was just thinking that right now, 
the setting sun brings me more relief than 
the rising sun..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! Um... I-I was just talking about 
my preferences, you know!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Phew.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Today was so much fun... Trainer-san 
really is amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...That was really, truly fun.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(If I just gave up on everything, I wonder 
if I could spend every day like this...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Calm and gentle. Days without a single 
worry—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Wh-What are you thinking...?! Idiot!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, this won't do. I have to do 
something about this—)

The new year has begun, kicking off the 
Senior Year. I want to do my best together 
with Win Variation for another year.
